verse_text_english: Among our creations, there are those who guide with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِمَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ أُمَّةٌ يَهْدُونَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَبِهِۦ يَعْدِلُونَ

verse_text_english: As for those who reject our revelations, we lead them on whence they never know.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

verse_text_english: Have they not looked at the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all the things created by GOD? Does it ever occur to them that the end of their life may be near? Which Hadith, besides this, do they believe in?
verse_text_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا۟ فِى مَلَكُوتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ وَأَنْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَدِ ٱقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verse_text_english: He created you from one person (Adam). Subsequently, He gives every man a mate to find tranquility with her. She then carries a light load that she hardly notices. As the load gets heavier, they implore GOD their Lord: “If You give us a good baby, we will be appreciative.”

verse_text_english: You shall resort to pardon, advocate tolerance, and disregard the ignorant.

verse_text_english: When the devil whispers to you any whisper, seek refuge in GOD; He is Hearer, Omniscient.

verse_text_english: If you do not produce a miracle that they demand, they say, “Why not ask for it?” Say, “I simply follow what is revealed to me from my Lord.” These are enlightenments from your Lord, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَأْتِهِم بِـَٔايَةٍ قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا ٱجْتَبَيْتَهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَتَّبِعُ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ مِن رَّبِّى هَٰذَا بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

verse_text_english: When the Quran is recited, you shall listen to it and take heed, that you may attain mercy.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥ وَأَنصِتُوا۟ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idhā quri-a l-qur'ānu fa-is'tamiʿū lahu wa-anṣitū laʿallakum tur'ḥamūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذا قرئ القرءان فاستمعوا له وأنصتوا لعلكم ترحمون

verse_text_english: You shall remember your Lord within yourself, publicly, privately, and day and night; do not be unaware.*
